# nd_multi_cluster_connectivity_aci (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_multi_cluster_connectivity_aci" "test_resource_multi_cluster_connectivity_aci_1" {
  cluster_type              = "APIC"
  cluster_name              = "ins15-apic1"
  host_name                 = "10.195.219.153:443"
  user_name                 = "admin"
  password                  = "Q2lzY29pbnMzOTY1IQ=="
  login_domain              = "DefaultAuth"
  fabric_name               = "ins15-apic1"
  license_tier              = "premier"
  security_domain           = "all"
  validate_peer_certificate = false
  enable_orchestration      = "enabled"
  enable_telemetry          = "enabled"
  telemetry_collection      = "inband"
  telemetry_streaming       = "ipv4"
  telemetry_epg             = "uni/tn-mgmt/mgmtp-default/inb-default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_name` (String) The IP address used to communicate with the Cisco ACI cluster. Corresponds
to the "Host Name/IP Address" field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster"
workflow. Do not include the protocol (http:// or https://) as part of the
value or fabric onboarding will fail. An optional ":port" suffix is supported.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password for the user name with admin privileges on the ACI fabric
being added. Corresponds to the "Password" field in the Nexus Dashboard
"Connect Cluster" workflow.
- `user_name` (String, Sensitive) Login user name with admin privileges on the ACI fabric being added.
Corresponds to the "User Name" field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster"
workflow. The credentials are used once when first establishing connectivity
to the cluster; all subsequent communication uses provisioned secure keys.

### Optional

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the APIC cluster as reported by the controller.
- `cluster_type` (String) The type of the cluster. The value will be auto filled as "APIC" for this resource.
- `enable_orchestration` (String) Enables or disables Cisco ACI in Nexus Dashboard Orchestration on this
ACI fabric. When enabled, Nexus Dashboard can deploy tenants, networks,
and policy configurations across multiple ACI sites. Allowed values:
"enabled", "disabled". Note: Orchestration cannot be enabled on an ACI
fabric that is a member of a VXLAN-ACI fabric group.
- `enable_telemetry` (String) Enables or disables Telemetry for the ACI fabric. Corresponds to the
"Enable telemetry" checkbox in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster"
workflow. This is the equivalent of enabling the Nexus Dashboard Insights
service in previous releases. Allowed values: "enabled", "disabled".
- `fabric_name` (String) A unique name assigned to the ACI fabric. Corresponds to the "Fabric Name"
field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster" workflow. This value is set
only at onboarding time and cannot be changed in place.
- `latitude` (Number) Geolocation latitude of the ACI fabric. Part of the "Location" selection
shown in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster" workflow.
- `license_tier` (String) The licensing tier to be used with this ACI fabric. Corresponds to the
"License tier" field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster" workflow.
Allowed values: "essentials", "advantage", "premier".
- `login_domain` (String, Sensitive) The login domain to use when authenticating with the ACI fabric.
Corresponds to the optional "Login Domain" field in the Nexus Dashboard
"Connect Cluster" workflow. If left empty, the fabric's local login is used.
- `longitude` (Number) Geolocation longitude of the ACI fabric. Part of the "Location" selection
shown in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster" workflow.
- `security_domain` (String) The security domain used for access control on the ACI fabric. Corresponds
to the "Security domain" field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster"
workflow. Only users with the "all" security domain access can add or
delete ACI clusters.
- `telemetry_collection` (String) The connectivity used for telemetry collection on the ACI fabric.
Corresponds to the "Telemetry collection" choice in the Nexus Dashboard
"Connect Cluster" workflow. Allowed values: "inband" (GUI: "In-band") or
"outOfBand" (GUI: "Out-of-band"). Regardless of the option chosen,
reachability to the ACI IP address must be through the Nexus Dashboard
data interface. Available only when telemetry is enabled.
- `telemetry_epg` (String) The APIC End Point Group (EPG) Distinguished Name (DN) used for telemetry
collection on the in-band management network. Required when
telemetry_collection is "inband". Available only when telemetry is enabled.
- `telemetry_streaming` (String) The streaming protocol used for ACI telemetry. Corresponds to the
"Telemetry streaming" choice in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster"
workflow. Allowed values: "ipv4" (GUI: "IPv4") or "ipv6" (GUI: "IPv6").
Available only when telemetry is enabled.
- `validate_peer_certificate` (Boolean) Allows Nexus Dashboard to verify that the certificates of hosts to which it
connects (such as fabric controllers) are valid and are signed by a trusted
Certificate Authority (CA). Corresponds to the "Validate peer certificate"
field in the Nexus Dashboard "Connect Cluster" workflow. The certificate
for the fabric must already be imported into Nexus Dashboard before
enabling this option, otherwise fabric onboarding will fail.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the terraform resource.
